about: DOM widget kits: custom-drawn web controls that expose NOTHING to the accessibility tree (no role, no state). Each entry describes a component pattern by CSS selectors - container, its label, which class means on, what to click - so the CDP adapter can add the control to the tree as an ordinary control type and the normal rules apply. Data about a UI component library, not code for one program: any page using the same component gets it.
